name: Crisis Signal → Immediate Slack + Discord Page

parameters.content:
## 11 · Crisis Signal → Immediate Slack + Discord Page (bonus)

**What it does:** Polls mentions on a fast cadence and fires the moment one contains a crisis keyword (lawsuit, outage, breach, scandal, layoff, bankruptcy…). It pages both Slack and Discord so the on-call sees it instantly.

**Setup**
1. **Crisis Watch** → set *Topic* (your brand) and edit *Crisis Keywords*. Use a short poll interval (e.g. 5 min) in Trigger settings.
2. **Slack** + **Discord** → set channel / webhook.

**Credentials & key**
- Crisis scan → **MentionFox connection token** (mentionfox.com/connect).
- (Paid FoxAPIs nodes elsewhere use your **FoxAPIs API key** from **foxapis.com** — never a MentionFox connection token.)

**Credit cost:** scan **3 cr per source** per poll — a fast cadence on many sources adds up, so scope *Sources* tightly.

Pricing: https://mentionfox.com/pricing
